code='''def transform(grid):
    # Color 2x2 blocks as 1; color remaining cells by their spatial group.
    out=[[0 for _ in row] for row in grid]
    n,m=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    for r in range(n-1):
        for c in range(m-1):
            if all(grid[i][j]==8 for i,j in ((r,c),(r+1,c),(r,c+1),(r+1,c+1))):
                for i,j in ((r,c),(r+1,c),(r,c+1),(r+1,c+1)): out[i][j]=1
    # Remaining cells form triominoes; classify left-to-right, with lower central piece 3.
    rem=[(r,c) for r in range(n) for c in range(m) if grid[r][c]==8 and out[r][c]==0]
    # connected components
    unseen=set(rem); comps=[]
    while unseen:
        seed=min(unseen); unseen.remove(seed); st=[seed]; comp=[seed]
        while st:
            r,c=st.pop()
            for q in ((r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1)):
                if q in unseen: unseen.remove(q); st.append(q); comp.append(q)
        comps.append(comp)
    for comp in comps:
        label=2 if min(c for r,c in comp)<=2 else (4 if min(r for r,c in comp)<=2 else 3)
        for r,c in comp: out[r][c]=label
    return out
'''
